caption:
Stop buying a shower liner that clings to your leg.

Thin plastic liners billow in as the water heats up, so they stick to your skin halfway through a shower. Cheap liners also hold onto soap film and mildew spots fast, so they look dingy within weeks no matter how often you wipe them down.

This is an Oeko-tex certified liner in the standard size, made to hang flat along the tub instead of ballooning inward. People rate it 4.5 stars, and over a hundred thousand reviews are on it.

A liner that stays put and still looks clean after regular use, for about $9.
